QuestInfo.name: [Silent Crusade] To the Past
QuestInfo.1: Take the Crack in Time to meet Lora and Starling in the past, then chase down Arkarium.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Can proceed to [Silent Crusade] Encounter With Lora quest

0.0: What did you learn?\r\n#L0##bI found a path to some other timey-wimey dimensional place! It was neat! Oh, also, the Goddess of Time was there!#l\n#k
0.1: You met the Goddess of Time? Unbelievable! Incomprehensible! Tell me more!\r\n#L0# #bArkarium went to the past to get rid of the heroes!#l\n#k
0.2: *gasp* Why would he do that?! \r\n#L0# #bIs he trying to make sure the Black Mage's seal was never created by getting rid of the heroes?#l\n#k

yes.0: Go through the crack. #bLora#k and #bStarling#k will meet you there. I'm counting on you three to beat Arkarium!

no.0: Get ready, and be quick about it! If you delay, it'll be a real disaster.

0.3: That makes sense, but the Black Mage is already resurrected. It would be more efficient for him to plan for the future...\r\n#L0##b #l\n#k
0.4:
Oh, wait. Heroes are the biggest threat to the Black Mage. Without the heroes, the Black Mage would never have been sealed. It seems like he is trying to get rid of the heroes so that the seal isn't created again. If that's not it...
\r\n#L0# #bThen? #l\n#k
0.5: It could be both. Whatever his intentions, Arkarium's aim to harm the heroes remains unchanged.\r\n#L0##b #l\n#k
0.6: What a disaster! We must chase after Arkarium and stop him before he's able to carry out his plan in the past! Are you ready?

1.0: Hello. Is this is our first time meeting? You're the newbie, right? Nice to meet you. I'm Lora, and this is Sun.
